name: aimux-cli
description: Local agent multiplexer for AI coding tools with native TUIs

scripts.dev:gui:web: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:web:local
scripts.dev:gui:web:relay: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:web:relay
scripts.dev:gui:native: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:native:local
scripts.dev:gui:native:relay: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:native:relay
scripts.dev:gui:ios: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:ios:local
scripts.dev:gui:ios:relay: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:ios:relay
scripts.dev:gui:android: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:android:local
scripts.dev:gui:android:relay: aimux daemon ensure && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app dev:android:relay
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && scripts/run-yarn --cwd relay install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile && scripts/run-yarn --cwd relay typecheck
scripts.audit:parser: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --test fixture_agent_contracts fixture_agent_output_parser
scripts.audit:parser:strict: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --test fixture_agent_contracts fixture_agent_output_parser && ./scripts/audit-fixture-enforcement.mjs --suite=fixture_agent_contracts --corpus=testdata/contracts/v1/agent-output/parser-adversarial.json
scripts.verify:fast: scripts/run-yarn verify:push && scripts/run-yarn lint && scripts/run-yarn native:fmt:check && scripts/run-yarn native:clippy:all-targets && scripts/run-yarn native:local-boundary && scripts/run-yarn security:local-only:gate && scripts/run-yarn check:local-build-boundary && scripts/run-yarn audit:rust-orphans && scripts/run-yarn audit:parser:strict && scripts/run-yarn audit:async-blocking && scripts/run-yarn audit:async-seams && scripts/run-yarn audit:async-clippy && scripts/run-yarn audit:contract-secrets && scripts/run-yarn audit:live-residual-isolation
scripts.verify:full: scripts/run-yarn verify:fast && scripts/run-yarn native:test && scripts/run-yarn test && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app lint --max-warnings=0 && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app test
scripts.verify:push: scripts/run-yarn typecheck && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app typecheck && scripts/run-yarn hook:attest
scripts.verify:app: scripts/run-yarn --cwd app typecheck && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app lint --max-warnings=0 && scripts/run-yarn --cwd app test
scripts.release:readiness: scripts/run-yarn verify:full && scripts/run-yarn audit:idle-process-spawn && scripts/run-yarn installed:gate && scripts/run-yarn installed:local-gate
scripts.native:clippy: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux -- -D warnings
scripts.native:clippy:all-targets: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p aimux --all-targets -- -D warnings

author: Sam <sam@tealstreet.io>
